event: → Bash: cd /home/maguire/Documents/chipbag/targets/opentitan/hw/ip/aon_timer; sed -n 25,40p doc/theory_of_operation.md; grep -n -i "thold" data/aon_timer.hjson | head -30

I verified the finding: it's a typo in the aon_timer docs, and the register for wakeup threshold bits [31:0] is `WKUP_THOLD_LO`.

Line 32 of `hw/ip/aon_timer/doc/theory_of_operation.md` names `WKUP_THOLD_HI` for bits[31:0], while its link goes to `#wkup_thold_lo`. The same document already gives `WKUP_THOLD_HI` bits[63:32] on line 31. `aon_timer.hjson` defines `WKUP_THOLD_LO` as bits 31:0.

The fix is to change the link text on line 32 from `WKUP_THOLD_HI` to `WKUP_THOLD_LO`. I didn't read the RTL.

The verdict was accepted.
